content.text: Entire keeps checkpoints in two stores: fresh local repositories get one ref per checkpoint under `refs/entire/checkpoints/<last two chars>/<id>`, while mirror-connected repositories like this one keep every checkpoint on the shared `entire/checkpoints/v1` branch under `<first two chars>/<rest of id>/`. The intent reader only knew the per-checkpoint refs store, so running merge-radar on this repository's own branches reported every one of its six checkpoints as missing even though they were all present on the v1 branch. `FindCheckpoint` in `internal/gitutil/checkpoint_refs.go` validates the id, tries the per-checkpoint ref first, then checks each local or remote-tracking v1 branch for `<dir>/metadata.json`, and returns a `CheckpointLocation` (revision plus directory) whose `Path` and `Tree` helpers let the reader list and read files uniformly from either layout. The new test, `TestCheckpointIntentsReadsTheSharedV1Branch`, builds the v1 layout from real git objects and proves the reader resolves a checkpoint stored only on that branch, while also confirming that a checkpoint in neither store is reported as missing with a note naming both stores.
